Cash revenue retention: NRR & GRR

Always calculated on cash revenue, by primary account. Follows your slicers.

By BU

Click a BU to filter. NRR = (starting revenue + expansion − contraction − churn) ÷ starting revenue. GRR leaves out expansion. New accounts are excluded from both.
